description: Defines the QuicStreamSendBuffer class and related structures for managing stream data in QUIC protocol implementation, including buffering, acknowledgment, retransmission, and data slices.

classes.name: BufferedSlice
classes.description: Represents a piece of stream data stored in memory with an associated offset.

classes.name: StreamPendingRetransmission
classes.description: Represents a pending retransmission with offset and length.

classes.name: QuicStreamSendBuffer
classes.description: Manages buffering, acknowledgment, and retransmission of stream data in QUIC.

methods.name: SaveStreamData
methods.description: Saves raw stream data into the send buffer.

methods.name: SaveMemSlice
methods.description: Saves a memory slice into the send buffer.

methods.name: SaveMemSliceSpan
methods.description: Saves multiple memory slices into the send buffer, returning total bytes saved.

methods.name: OnStreamDataConsumed
methods.description: Updates buffer state when data has been consumed.

methods.name: WriteStreamData
methods.description: Writes stream data starting at a specific offset to a writer.

methods.name: OnStreamDataAcked
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of data within a range, removing fully acknowledged slices.

methods.name: OnStreamDataLost
methods.description: Marks data within a range as lost for retransmission.

methods.name: OnStreamDataRetransmitted
methods.description: Marks data within a range as retransmitted.

methods.name: HasPendingRetransmission
methods.description: Checks if there are pending retransmissions.

methods.name: IsStreamDataOutstanding
methods.description: Checks if data within a range is outstanding and awaiting acknowledgment.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of data slices in the send buffer.

methods.name: stream_bytes_written
methods.description: Returns total bytes written to the stream.

methods.name: bytes_acked
methods.description: Returns the set of acknowledged byte ranges.

methods.name: pending_retransmissions
methods.description: Returns the set of data ranges pending retransmission.
